title: Unflinching Protector Amulet
summary: Use a Reaction to make an attack targeting a nearby ally miss.

fields.Unflinching Protection: Once per Long Rest, spend your Reaction when a nearby ally is targeted to make the attack miss. It cannot protect you. The prompt can trigger even when the attack already misses, so decline then.
fields.Recharge quirk: The pinned source reports that after the Long Rest you must unequip and re-equip the amulet to reactivate it.
fields.Acquisition: Worn by Ptaris. Give Lady Esther the githyanki egg for Steal a Githyanki Egg to encounter him.
fields.Base value: 210 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
